title: Listen to Riley Green’s SiriusXM Concert Featuring New ‘That’s Just Me’ Songs
summary: Can't make the show? Tune in to the country star's exclusive performance in October on The Highway.
body_markdown:
Riley Green **** will take the stage for a SiriusXM live performance on October 8 at The Underground in Charlotte, North Carolina, ahead of[NASCAR](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/category/sports/nascar) ’s Bank of America 400.


As part of SiriusXM’s *Play On* series presented by ** Spectrum, the intimate show will feature the country music singer-songwriter performing songs from his highly anticipated new album, *That’s Just Me,* and fan favorite hits.


“I’m excited to play The Underground in Charlotte and get to share some of these new songs from *That’s Just Me* with the fans,” said Riley Green. It’ll be a great way to kick off race weekend.”


### **How to Listen on SiriusXM**


SiriusXM listeners will be able to hear the full performance on[The Highway (Ch. 56)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/the-highway) on Friday, October 16 at 8pm ET with multiple replays throughout the following days.


[The Highway Country’s next generation Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogTagPage-TheHighway)


### **How to Attend**


SiriusXM subscribers and fans can enter for a chance to win a pair of tickets to the show sponsored by Spectrum – click[HERE](https://www.siriusxm.com/rileygreentixPR) for full details. If you do not live in the Charlotte, NC area, you can also enter for your chance to win a trip to the concert – click[HERE](https://www.siriusxm.com/RileyGreentripPR) for full details. On site at the show, SiriusXM and Spectrum will provide an engaging experience for fans with special surprises and giveaways.


### **About SiriusXM’s *Play On* Series**


Riley Green’s show marks the second show in SiriusXM’s *Play On* series presented by ** Spectrum *,* a lineup of intimate performances from the artists you love, surrounding the sports you live for, giving fans an unforgettable opportunity to see some of music’s biggest stars up close. Additionally, as part of the series, DJ duo Two Friends will perform in Columbus, Ohio, to kick off the college football season.
